text:
Maya: Heads-up — our SIEM is spamming PREAUTH_FAILURE alerts from internal build agents since ~03:10 UTC. Looks like noise but needs quick triage. cc @ops-oncall
ops-oncall: Yep, I'm getting pages. Any idea region/source?
ajay: Most hits are from eu-west-1 IP blocks and user_agent = 'Packer/1.7.8'. Looks like our nightly image builds hitting ssh endpoints during teardown.
linh: If it's Packer we should suppress but carefully. We can't blanket-suppress preauth failures — risk missing real brute force.
sam: Quick mitigation: lower severity for events where user_agent contains 'Packer' AND src_ip in build_pool_cidrs. Also add enrichment tag 'automation:build-pool'.
security-bot: Alert summary: PREAUTH_FAILURE rate x3 (03:12 UTC). Top user_agent: Packer/1.7.8, top src_cidr: 10.45.0.0/16.
Maya: Good. Idea: add a temporary suppression rule that groups identical user_agent bursts. If >50 failures from same user_agent within 5m, mark LOW and suppress noise to pager but keep a metric.
ajay: I'll propose a quick SIEM rule tweak — narrow condition + canary counter. Sample KQL to add: ```kql
event.action == "preauth_failure" AND NOT user_agent : "Packer*"
```
linh: Instead of NOT, prefer enrichment: tag known build hosts and exclude by tag. That avoids missing other legit Packer-like agents. Also keep an alert if failures are across >3 distinct usernames.
sam: I'll add a dashboard panel: auth_failures by user_agent + top src_cidrs, and update the runbook with the suppression decision.
ops-oncall: Do the rule change but add a canary rule that still counts unique usernames and raises HIGH if unique_user_count > 3 in the same window. :thumbsup:
Maya: After ajay pushes the change, please post the rule diff here. We'll review and schedule a permanent fix: tagging hosts at provisioning and adding a whitelist filter in SIEM.
ajay: Will push a small rule change now and create a PR for the long-term enrichment work. PR will include the exact CIDRs and example query.
security-bot: Change log: temporary suppression rule applied by ajay at 03:25 UTC. Pager noise reduced.
Maya: Thanks team. Follow-up: quick retro in eng-security tomorrow to ensure we don't accidentally suppress real incidents. Also add the new dashboard panel to the oncall rota. @sam @ajay
sam: On it — will add to runbook and link Grafana panel to the alert.
linh: I'll draft a short note for infra so build pool hosts get the 'role:build-pool' tag in userdata.
Maya: Great. Closing this thread once PR merges and runbook updated. :white_check_mark:
